historical_record.description: A recycling and transfer facility operated on the property, proposed to be housed in a one-storey building of 30,000 square feet.

On discretionary review, the City Planning Commission approved with conditions, 4-0, a 30,000-square-foot one-storey building to house the recycling and transfer facility already operating on the site (Motion 13800).
